title: Bound on the round count
statement: For every CNF formula $\varphi$ over natural-number-indexed variables, its round count is at most the length of its binary serialization.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula $\varphi$ over natural-number-indexed variables
replaced:
For every CNF formula $\varphi$, the round count of $\varphi$ is at most the
length of the serialization of $\varphi$: every non-finished round consumes at
least one input bit, including for empty clauses and the empty formula.
